headline: St. Thomas Aquinas pull clear as the last unbeaten side
dek: St. Thomas Aquinas met every other member without losing to any of them, and have now beaten Mercy again. D'Youville, who beat Molloy on the same day, come next, and they and Molloy are the only members to have taken a point off them.
displaced_by: St. Thomas Aquinas beat Mercy, so the standing dek's line that Mercy were the next to try is no longer true; the headline still holds
